item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa Bay organizations send solar panels, food and medicine to Cuba amid ongoing crisis
item.description: Two Tampa Bay nonprofits are sending solar panels, food and medicine to help people in Cuba amid power outages and food shortages.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Senate votes to advance new sanctions on Russia, named for Sen. Lindsey Graham
item.description: The U.S. Senate Tuesday voted 86-12 to advance a bill named for Sen. Lindsey Graham that, if approved in the House and signed into law, would place new sanctions on Russian energy and investment.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lakeland homeowner questions utility pole inspection after damage raises safety concerns
item.description: A Lakeland woman fears a damaged utility pole in front of her home could be a safety hazard and is questioning the city’s inspection process.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Technology issues cause brief ground stop for American Airlines flights
item.description: American Airlines briefly halted flight departures in the U.S. Tuesday due to technical issue. The carrier says flights are expected to resume now that the outage has been addressed.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for July 28
item.description: Fishback demands Collins resign after winning Florida ballot fight, Pasco County teen flies himself to world's largest aviation gathering, rain lingering

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Senate confirms Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence
item.description: The Senate has confirmed Jay Clayton as the head of the nation's intelligence agencies, ensuring that a permanent director is in place as the midterm elections approach.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US intercepts Iranian 'surprise attack' in the Middle East, CENTCOM says
item.description: U.S. Central Command said Tuesday it intercepted what it called a "surprise attack" on U.S. forces by Iran.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Crews place protective dividers along St. Petersburg bike lanes
item.description: Crews in St. Petersburg are placing new protective street dividers along major traffic corridors to keep cars out of bike lanes and increase rider safety.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Small town leaders in Polk County push back against proposed Amendment 3
item.description: Small-town leaders in Polk County are pushing back against a proposed state amendment that would dramatically raise Florida's homestead exemption, warning the change could cripple municipal budgets.
